description: This file handles the removal of dashboard pages in the SuiteCRM 'Home' module. It checks user preferences, presents a confirmation form, and upon confirmation, deletes the specified page and updates user preferences accordingly, then redirects back to the 'Home' index.

classes.name: SugarApplication
classes.description: Handles application-level operations such as redirects in SuiteCRM.

methods.name: getPreference
methods.description: Retrieves user preference data, such as dashboard pages.

methods.name: setPreference
methods.description: Sets user preference data, such as dashboard pages.

methods.name: redirect
methods.description: Redirects the user to a different URL.
